question: What is the most appropriate title for the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Volcano Walking- A Unique Experience**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage gives the description of the Thrihnukagigur volcano by mentioning all its **natural beauty**, as well as the physical details of the **natural phenomenon** like the subterranean walls, that are scorched with colours from a divine palette and the base of the crater which is very vast. The vastness of it can feel overwhelming; it is the size of a cathedral and the Statue of Liberty could easily fit into the shaft.
 
• The passage also mentions how the Thrihnukagigur volcano became a **tourist attraction**. The first 'volcano tourists' entered the volcano in 2005 and it has since been labelled as one of the unique tourist attractions in the world.
 
• The last paragraph of the passage mentions that it is a **soul-enriching experience** and visitors often report feeling deeply moved by the beauty and tranquillity of the volcano that was once so destructive and angry.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**.
